description: Creates or updates marketing segments, matched by ItemId.

items.description: A segment of customers, chosen by their orders, spending and country.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Rules.description: The rules a customer matches: MinOrders, MaxOrders, MinSpent, MaxSpent, LastOrderAtLeastDaysAgo, LastOrderWithinDays, FirstOrderWithinDays and Country (a two-letter code).

Segments.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
